validation.duplicateName: A record with this name already exists.
validation.positiveNumber: Enter a number greater than zero (up to 2 decimals).

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Areas that group compounds. Inactive locations are hidden from agents.
locations.activeHint: Inactive locations and their compounds are hidden from the agent catalogue.
locations.deactivateBody: {{count}} compound(s) in this location will be hidden from agents. You can reactivate it at any time.

compounds.title: Compounds
compounds.description: Developments, their details, amenities and publication status.
compounds.createHint: Start with the essentials. You can add address, description, amenities and media afterwards.
compounds.unpublishBody: Agents will no longer see this compound or its unit models in the catalogue.
compounds.amenitiesHint: Add each amenity in English and, optionally, Arabic.

compoundDetail.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or the link is incorrect.
compoundDetail.overviewHint: Bilingual details shown to agents in the catalogue.
compoundDetail.noModels: No unit models in this compound yet

propertyTypes.title: Property types
propertyTypes.description: Configurable categories such as apartment, villa or townhouse.
propertyTypes.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Cannot be changed later.
propertyTypes.keyInvalid: Use 2–32 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter.
propertyTypes.keyTaken: This key is already in use.
propertyTypes.deactivateBody: {{count}} unit model(s) use this type. They stay as they are, but the type can't be chosen for new unit models.

unitModels.title: Unit models
unitModels.description: Layouts offered in each compound, with structured specifications and extra details.
unitModels.formHint: Structured fields are shown consistently to agents; extra specifications cover anything else.
unitModels.deleteBody: This unit model has {{count}} price(s). It will be removed from the catalogue together with its prices and media.
unitModels.extraSpecsHint: Key/value details such as garden size, down payment or delivery date.
unitModels.noSpecs: No extra specifications. Add a row for any detail not covered above.
unitModels.specsIncomplete: Each row needs an English label and value.
unitModels.specsDuplicate: Each label can only be used once.
unitModels.specsLangHint: Arabic is optional; English is used when it's empty.

media.title: Media library
media.description: Images, floor plans and videos attached to compounds and unit models.
media.uploadHint: Files are checked here first and validated again by the server.
media.kindHint: PDFs are always stored as floor plans.
media.privateNote: Files are kept in private storage and are only shown to signed-in users through short-lived signed links.
media.dropHint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to {{image}} MB · PDF floor plans · MP4 up to {{video}} MB

rules.images: Images: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {{image}} MB each.
rules.floorPlans: Floor plans: PDF or PNG, up to {{image}} MB each.
rules.videos: Videos: MP4, up to {{video}} MB each.

errors.videoSize: {{name}}: larger than the {{video}} MB video limit.

media.noFilesSelected: Choose at least one file to upload.
media.removeBody: {{name}} will be removed from storage and from the catalogue.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Listed prices per unit model. Every change is recorded in the price history.
pricing.search: Search by unit model or label…
pricing.label: Label
pricing.amountHint: Digits with up to 2 decimals, e.g. 6850000.00
pricing.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, with up to 12 digits and 2 decimals.
pricing.currencyChangeWarning: The amount will be stored in {{to}} instead of {{from}}. It is not converted — make sure the figure is in {{to}}.
pricing.readOnly: Read only — your role can't change prices.
pricing.confirmBody: Price changes are recorded in the audit log and the price history with your name and the time.
pricing.historyHint: Append-only. Previous values are never edited or deleted.
